depends_on: circulant determinant = product of DFT eigenvalues (Mathlib)
von Sterneck formula for Ramanujan sums
notes: M = C P with C circulant of g(m)=[gcd(m,n)=1], P: j->-j, det P = (-1)^floor((n-1)/2); eigenvalues of C are Ramanujan sums mu(n/d)phi(n)/phi(n/d); sign Prod_{e|n} mu(e)^{phi(e)} = -1 iff n even. Gives (-1)^{n(n-1)/2} a(n) > 0 and Oudra's formula a(n) = (-1)^floor(n/2) Prod_{d|n} phi(d)^{phi(n/d)} for squarefree n. check.py: n<=30. Outside Lean: the circulant argument (standard eigenvalue formula, von Sterneck), written out in the README.

prior_art.note: No proof found; circulant diagonalisation is classical, so the proof is immediate.
